baseVariables.name: base-primary-color
baseVariables.usage: Selected nodes, context menu accents, scroll highlight, empty zone

baseVariables.name: base-primary-bg-subtle
baseVariables.usage: Primary tint for the node-info hover (selection reads --base-selected-bg)

baseVariables.name: base-danger-bg-subtle
baseVariables.usage: Invalid drop target background, context menu danger item hover

baseVariables.name: base-drop-target-bg
baseVariables.usage: Valid drop target while dragging: drag-over row, empty-tree drop placeholder (= success-bg-subtle)

baseVariables.name: base-drop-target-bg-active
baseVariables.usage: Drop target under the pointer: the row accepting the drop, engaged placeholder (= success-bg-subtle-hover)

baseVariables.name: base-drop-target-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Drop target border / outline (= success-color); a refused drop keeps the danger tint

baseVariables.name: base-disabled-opacity
baseVariables.usage: Disabled tree, checkbox and context menu item opacity

baseVariables.name: base-overlay-bg
baseVariables.usage: Context menu phone sheet backdrop (core menu)

baseVariables.name: base-touch-target-min
baseVariables.usage: Context menu phone sheet row and close button minimum size (core menu)

baseVariables.name: base-border-width
baseVariables.usage: Hairline stroke width (context menu, checkbox, debug panel)

baseVariables.name: base-z-tooltip
baseVariables.usage: Node tooltip stacking; the drop-zone overlay and touch ghost sit just above it

baseVariables.name: base-outline-width
baseVariables.usage: Shared item-ring thickness; drives --wtv-focused-outline-offset (inset) and the fallback ring width

baseVariables.name: base-selected-outline
baseVariables.usage: Shared selected-item ring, outline shorthand drawn inset (drives --wtv-selected-outline)

baseVariables.name: base-focused-outline
baseVariables.usage: Shared focused (cursor) item ring, outline shorthand drawn inset (drives --wtv-focused-outline)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-1
baseVariables.usage: Primary text (node labels, context menu items)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-3
baseVariables.usage: Secondary text (node paths, toggle icons, divider labels)

baseVariables.name: base-hover-bg
baseVariables.usage: Node hover background, context menu item hover

baseVariables.name: base-danger-color
baseVariables.usage: Invalid drop indicator, context menu danger items

baseVariables.name: base-icon-check
baseVariables.usage: Checkbox checkmark glyph; chained by --wtv-icon-check — mask-image

baseVariables.name: base-icon-indeterminate
baseVariables.usage: Tri-state (partial) checkbox dash glyph; chained by --wtv-icon-indeterminate — mask-image

baseVariables.name: base-icon-check-size
baseVariables.usage: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the checkbox box; chained by --wtv-icon-check-size (default 68%)

baseVariables.name: base-checkbox-scale
baseVariables.usage: Shared checkbox scale knob; chained by --wtv-checkbox-scale (box/border/radius × this via calc, no transform)

baseVariables.name: base-checkbox-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Dedicated checkbox border color (stronger than --base-border-color); chained by --wtv-checkbox-border-color

baseVariables.name: base-input-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Control outline; chained by --wtv-input-border-color (the checkbox border's standalone default)

baseVariables.name: base-shadow-color
baseVariables.usage: Shadow tint; chained by --wtv-shadow-color (tooltip, context menu, touch ghost shadows standalone)

baseVariables.name: base-loader-duration
baseVariables.usage: Loader loop period (slows under reduced motion) — --wtv-loader-duration

baseVariables.name: base-scroll-behavior
baseVariables.usage: Scroll behaviour (smooth; auto under reduced motion) — --wtv-scroll-behavior

baseVariables.name: base-ease-standard
baseVariables.usage: Shared easing curve (ms --ms-easing-snappy parity) — node/checkbox/toggle transitions. cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) fallback.

componentVariables.name: wtv-rem
componentVariables.usage: Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default: 10px)

componentVariables.name: wtv-text-color-3
componentVariables.usage: Tertiary text — toggle glyph, info button, paths, "loading more" (reads --base-text-color-3)

componentVariables.name: wtv-danger-color
componentVariables.usage: Danger role fill — invalid drop, drag-denied (reads --base-danger-color)

componentVariables.name: wtv-danger-text-color
componentVariables.usage: Danger as text — menu danger item (reads --base-danger-text-color)

componentVariables.name: wtv-selected-bg
componentVariables.usage: Selected-row background tint (the click / Ctrl / Shift-click set); reads --base-selected-bg (fallback --base-primary-bg-subtle, then accent 10% / 20% dark)

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-bg
componentVariables.usage: Background of the focused (cursor) row when not selected; reads --base-focused-bg (fallback transparent)

componentVariables.name: wtv-selected-fill-bg
componentVariables.usage: Background for the opt-in .wtv__node-content--selected-fill flavor (Explorer-style strong fill); unused by the default selected state

componentVariables.name: wtv-selected-preset-ring-color
componentVariables.usage: Hairline ring color of the opt-in --selected-border / --selected-glow presets (accent 45%)

componentVariables.name: wtv-selected-outline
componentVariables.usage: Selected row outline shorthand, drawn inset (reads --base-selected-outline)

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-outline
componentVariables.usage: Focus ring outline shorthand, drawn inset (reads --base-focused-outline)

componentVariables.name: wtv-selected-fill-text-color
componentVariables.usage: Text color of the opt-in --selected-fill flavor

componentVariables.name: wtv-transition-normal
componentVariables.usage: Normal transition — toggle, hover, tooltip, drop zones (reads --base-duration-normal, 0.15s; 0s under reduced motion)

componentVariables.name: wtv-transition-slow
componentVariables.usage: Slow transition — drag-denied tint (reads --base-duration-slow, 0.3s; 0s under reduced motion)

componentVariables.name: wtv-toggle-icon-transition
componentVariables.usage: Expand / collapse turn of the glyph

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-outline-offset
componentVariables.usage: Outline offset for the focus ring / selected ring (default calc(-1 * var(--base-outline-width, 1px)) = inset)

componentVariables.name: wtv-scroll-behavior
componentVariables.usage: scrollToPath / paste-reveal scrolling behaviour when the caller passes none; keyboard moves always scroll instantly (reads --base-scroll-behavior, smooth; auto under reduced motion)

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-border-radius
componentVariables.usage: Corner radius of the row pill

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-icon-color
componentVariables.usage: Per-node icon color (default currentColor; overridden by a per-node iconColor / iconColorMember)

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-icon-margin-right
componentVariables.usage: Gap between the per-node icon and the label

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-icon-width
componentVariables.usage: Reserved icon-column width when shouldAlignNodeIcons is on

componentVariables.name: wtv-toggle-icon-size
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph size (font-size of the toggle column)

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-expand
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph mask (collapsed / the only glyph in rotate mode); chained to --base-icon-chevron. Re-pointed per icon-set.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-collapse
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph mask shown when expanded (swap mode only); chained to --base-icon-collapse for the plus-minus set.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-leaf
componentVariables.usage: Optional leaf marker glyph mask (opt-in via leafIconClass=wtv__toggle-icon--leaf).

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-rotate-collapsed
componentVariables.usage: Collapsed-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (0deg for a right-pointing chevron, -90deg for a down-caret).

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-rotate-expanded
componentVariables.usage: Expanded-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (90deg for chevron).

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-check
componentVariables.usage: Checkmark glyph (mask) for a checked checkbox; chains to --base-icon-check.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-indeterminate
componentVariables.usage: Dash glyph (mask) for a tri-state/partial checkbox; chains to --base-icon-indeterminate.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-check-size
componentVariables.usage: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the box; chains to --base-icon-check-size (default 68%).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-gap
componentVariables.usage: Space between the checkbox and the node pill

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-scale
componentVariables.usage: Box/border/radius scale via calc (shared --base-checkbox-scale contract, no transform).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-border-width
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox box border thickness (→ --wtv-border-width; multiplied by --wtv-checkbox-scale).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-border-color
componentVariables.usage: Unchecked checkbox box border color; chains to --base-checkbox-border-color.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-border-radius
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox box corner radius (flat 0.3×rem, scaled by --wtv-checkbox-scale).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checked-bg
componentVariables.usage: Checked / indeterminate checkbox box background (defaults to the accent color).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checked-border-color
componentVariables.usage: Checked / indeterminate checkbox box border color.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checked-bg-hover
componentVariables.usage: Checked / indeterminate checkbox background on hover (accent hover step).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checkmark-color
componentVariables.usage: Check / dash glyph color (tints the mask).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-width
componentVariables.usage: Focus-ring thickness for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-color
componentVariables.usage: Focus-ring color for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

componentVariables.name: wtv-drop-glow-child-color
componentVariables.usage: Glow + arrow color, drop as child

componentVariables.name: wtv-drag-over-glow-bg
componentVariables.usage: Drag-over row overlay gradient (::before, tinted by --base-drop-target-border-color)

componentVariables.name: wtv-drag-over-highlight-bg
componentVariables.usage: Row accepting the drop: background; reads --base-drop-target-bg-active

componentVariables.name: wtv-drag-over-highlight-border
componentVariables.usage: Row accepting the drop: border shorthand (--base-drop-target-border-color)

componentVariables.name: wtv-drag-denied-flash-bg
componentVariables.usage: Row tint when a node can't be dragged / dropped (fades in, held)

componentVariables.name: wtv-dragged-scale
componentVariables.usage: Scale of the dimmed dragged node(s), left-anchored (0.95; set 1 to disable)

componentVariables.name: wtv-cut-opacity
componentVariables.usage: Opacity of cut nodes pending paste (0.4)

componentVariables.name: wtv-tree-min-height
componentVariables.usage: Min height for empty and loading states (60px)

componentVariables.name: wtv-drop-placeholder-bg-hover
componentVariables.usage: Engaged placeholder (hover / drag over) background; = drag-over-highlight-bg

componentVariables.name: wtv-drop-placeholder-accent
componentVariables.usage: One accent driving the empty zone's border, text and icon; reads --base-drop-target-border-color

componentVariables.name: wtv-drop-placeholder-bg-armed
componentVariables.usage: Armed placeholder background (a node is dragged anywhere on the page); = drag-over-bg

componentVariables.name: wtv-drop-placeholder-icon
componentVariables.usage: Icon above the label (a mask filled with the accent); none drops it

componentVariables.name: wtv-tooltip-width
componentVariables.usage: Node tooltip width (auto = shrink-to-content; set a length for a fixed box + max-width:none)

componentVariables.name: wtv-tooltip-min-width
componentVariables.usage: Node tooltip minimum width (0 = none; a floor that still grows up to max-width)

componentVariables.name: wtv-tooltip-max-width
componentVariables.usage: Node tooltip max width (wrap point; set none when using a fixed width)

componentVariables.name: wtv-context-menu-item-gap
componentVariables.usage: Gap between icon, label, shortcut, arrow

componentVariables.name: wtv-context-menu-shortcut-color
componentVariables.usage: Shortcut text (and svelte submenu arrow) color

componentVariables.name: wtv-loader-icon
componentVariables.usage: Loader shape, a mask (reads --base-loader-icon; the contract's arc)

componentVariables.name: wtv-loader-rotate
componentVariables.usage: Loader rotation per loop (reads --base-loader-rotate, 1turn; 0 = the SVG animates itself)

componentVariables.name: wtv-loader-duration
componentVariables.usage: Loader loop period (reads --base-loader-duration, 0.8s; slows under reduced motion)

componentVariables.name: wtv-loader-size
componentVariables.usage: Loader size (reads --base-loader-size, 1.25em); the per-context sizes derive from it

componentVariables.name: wtv-loader-inline-size
componentVariables.usage: Per-node lazy-load loader size, in place of the toggle glyph (0.75 × --wtv-loader-size)

componentVariables.name: wtv-z-index-overlay
componentVariables.usage: Loading overlay, local to the tree
